tools.title: Cloudflare Aura-1

tools.title: Cloudflare Aura-2
tools.description: Enhanced quality text-to-speech with improved pronunciation and natural prosody. 40 English and 10 Spanish voices.

tools.title: Cloudflare MeloTTS
tools.description: Multi-lingual text-to-speech by MyShell AI. Supports 16+ languages with natural-sounding voices.

tools.title: Deepgram
tools.description: Deepgram Aura TTS with 100+ voices across 7 languages, low latency, and pronunciation control.

tools.title: ElevenLabs
tools.description: Highly expressive, natural ElevenLabs voices with 29+ languages and instant voice cloning support.

tools.title: OpenAI
tools.description: OpenAI speech (gpt-4o-mini-tts) with steerable delivery and 10 expressive built-in voices.

tools.title: Google Cloud Chirp 3 HD
tools.description: Google's highest-fidelity Chirp 3 HD voices. Eight expressive voices available across 30+ locales.

tools.title: Google Cloud Neural2
tools.description: High-quality neural text-to-speech voices from Google Cloud. Natural-sounding with 1M free characters per month.

tools.title: Google Cloud Standard
tools.description: Basic text-to-speech voices from Google Cloud. Affordable option with 4M free characters per month.

tools.title: Google Cloud Studio
tools.description: Premium studio-grade text-to-speech voices from Google Cloud. Professional quality for production audio.

tools.title: Whisper Large v3 Turbo from Cloudflare
tools.description: Opensource speech to text

tools.title: Official OpenAI Whisper v2
tools.description: Speech to text straight from the source

tools.title: Deepgram Nova-3
tools.description: Deepgram's Nova-3 speech-to-text — fast, accurate, multilingual

tools.title: Cartesia Voice Clone
tools.description: Creates an instant voice clone from a short audio clip (minimum 5 seconds)

tools.title: Google Chirp 3 Instant Custom Voice
tools.description: Creates a Chirp 3 voice cloning key from ~10s of reference audio plus a voice-talent consent recording. Requires Google allow-list access.

tools.title: Pyannote Voiceprint
tools.description: Creates a voice embedding from an audio sample for speaker identification

tools.title: Chunk Flagger
tools.description: Analyzes retrieved context chunks and flags problematic ones for removal (contradictions, irrelevant content, outdated info, etc.)

tools.title: Chunk Generator
tools.description: Will use an llm to generate new chunks to fix low scores. WARNING! This may cause hallucinations.

tools.title: Passage Selector (Jev)
tools.description: Fixes low scores only with text already in your corpus: Jev picks the passage that states the answer and it is added verbatim. When no passage states it, the question is escalated to a human instead of being filled.

tools.title: LangExtract
tools.description: Sentence-aware text chunking with three strategies respecting sentence boundaries. Fast, in-process — no external API calls. Built on Divinci's TypeScript port (@divinci-ai/langextract-ts) of Google's LangExtract.

tools.title: LiteParse → LangExtract
tools.description: LiteParse (LlamaIndex) parses the source document locally (layout, reading order, bounding boxes), then LangExtract (Google; Divinci TypeScript port) sentence-chunks the extracted text. Best of both: faithful binary-document parsing plus sentence-aware chunks.

tools.title: Open-Parse
tools.description: [DEPRECATED] Use LangExtract instead. Open-Parse semantically converts PDF files to text chunks but has been deprecated due to memory limits on large PDFs.

tools.title: Record Chunker
tools.description: One chunk per record, split on an explicit delimiter. For pre-chunked structured corpora (tables, catalogues, record exports) where sentence- or layout-based chunking would destroy row boundaries.

tools.title: Unstructured
tools.description: Unstructured is a tool for converting raw files to text chunks.

tools.title: Divinci GIM Cleaner
tools.description: Removes garbage text, fixes incomplete text, tracks and replaces pronouns and splits mixed text

tools.title: BAAI General Embedding
tools.description: transforms any given text into a 768-dimensional vector

tools.title: EmbeddingGemma 300m
tools.description: multilingual Gemma embedding model producing 768-dimensional vectors

tools.title: Gemini Embedding 001 (1536d)
tools.description: Google's gemini-embedding-001 model truncated to 1536 dimensions — recommended for qdrant-cosine and other 1536d collections.

tools.title: Gemini Embedding 001 (3072d)
tools.description: Google's gemini-embedding-001 at its full 3072 dimensions — highest retrieval quality. Not compatible with Cloudflare Vectorize (1536 max) or Couchbase (2048 max).

tools.title: Gemini Embedding 2 (1536d) — Preview
tools.description: Google's gemini-embedding-2-preview model truncated to 1536 dimensions via Matryoshka. 8K token input, multimodal capable. Best balance for qdrant-cosine and other 1536d collections.

tools.title: Vertex AI Text Embedding 005
tools.description: transforms any given text into a 768-dimensional vector using Google Vertex AI

tools.title: Voyage 3.5 (1024d)
tools.description: Previous-generation Voyage AI general-purpose embedding model

tools.title: Voyage 4 (1024d)
tools.description: Voyage AI's balanced general-purpose embedding model

tools.title: Voyage 4 Large (1024d)
tools.description: Voyage AI's highest-quality general-purpose embedding model

tools.title: Voyage 4 Lite (1024d)
tools.description: Voyage AI's low-latency, low-cost embedding model

tools.title: CloudFlare V2
tools.description: CloudFlare is a tool for vectorizing text.

tools.title: Couchbase (BYOK)
tools.description: Bring Your Own Couchbase Capella account for hyperscale vector search with billion-vector capability.

tools.title: PageIndex (Divinci)
tools.description: Reasoning-based RAG using hierarchical tree indexes. No vector database or embeddings needed. Hosted by Divinci.

tools.title: LightRAG (Graph)
tools.description: Knowledge graph-enhanced RAG with entity extraction and community-based retrieval. Builds on Microsoft GraphRAG research with Cloudflare Vectorize.

tools.title: MongoDB Atlas Vector Search
tools.description: Store and query vector embeddings directly in MongoDB Atlas with native vector search capabilities. Supports unlimited dimensions and integrates seamlessly with existing MongoDB data.

tools.title: Neo4j Hybrid (BYOK)
tools.description: Hybrid graph + vector RAG using Neo4j. Combines vector similarity with knowledge graph traversal for multi-hop retrieval.

tools.title: PageIndex (Cloud)
tools.description: Reasoning-based RAG using hierarchical tree indexes. No vector database or embeddings needed.

tools.title: Pinecone Serverless
tools.description: Bring your own Pinecone account. Each vector becomes a namespace inside a Divinci-managed serverless index sized to your embedding model.

tools.title: Qdrant Cosine
tools.description: Uses Qdrant collections to store and query chunks.

tools.title: RAPTOR
tools.description: Recursive Abstractive Processing for Tree-Organized Retrieval. Clusters chunks hierarchically, summarizes each level, and searches across all abstraction layers.

tools.title: Redis Vector Search
tools.description: High-performance vector similarity search using Redis Query Engine. Supports HNSW and FLAT indexing with cosine, L2, and inner product distance metrics.

tools.title: turbopuffer
tools.description: Bring your own turbopuffer account. Each vector becomes its own namespace (object-storage backed, cosine ANN).

tools.title: Turso libSQL
tools.description: Uses Turso (hosted libSQL/SQLite) tables with DiskANN vector indexes to store and query chunks.

tools.title: Vertex AI Vector Search
tools.description: Google Cloud's enterprise vector search built on ScaNN algorithm. Supports billions of vectors with low latency.

tools.title: Vertex AI Vector Search 2.0
tools.description: Google Cloud's next-gen vector search with Collections API. Fast setup (~5 min), self-tuning, supports billions of vectors. Beta.

tools.title: Brave Web Search
tools.description: Independent web search via Brave Search API. Privacy-focused search with web results, descriptions, and metadata.

tools.title: Exa Web Search
tools.description: AI-native web search via Exa API. Semantic web search with AI-curated results, highlights, and metadata.

tools.title: Serper (Google Search)
tools.description: Google Search results via Serper API. Fast, reliable web search with organic results, snippets, and metadata.

tools.title: TinyFish Search
tools.description: Browser-rendered live web search via the TinyFish Search API. Supports domain include/exclude, freshness windows, and news/research-paper modes.

tools.title: Cloudflare Browser Rendering
tools.description: Renders pages in a headless browser, capturing JavaScript-rendered content and images.

tools.title: Divinci HTML Scraper
tools.description: Fetches Url, processes html and turns it into markdown. **Doesn't wait for javascript to load.**

tools.title: FireCrawl Open Source
tools.description: Renders pages in a headless browser with JavaScript execution. Powered by self-hosted FireCrawl.

tools.title: FireCrawl Cloud
tools.description: Premium web scraping with anti-bot protection, IP rotation, and advanced features. Requires FireCrawl API key.

tools.title: TinyFish Fetch
tools.description: Fetches a URL and returns clean, model-ready content. Rejects private IPs, localhost and cloud metadata endpoints at the vendor.
